description: Word-like document editor shell backed by the document editor JSON provider contracts. Since the redesign (plan 146c7e1b, DE-1.1) it lays itself out from its OWN container: LayoutMode=Auto measures the editor through the shared TmLayoutObserver (first frame Desktop) and publishes the resolved mode as data-layout on the root. Desktop (container of 1024 px and more) renders three named regions - [data-region=nav] | [data-region=doc] | [data-region=inspector] - under a header (title, save state, actions; ShowHeader, Title, Subtitle, HeaderStart, HeaderActions) and the ribbon; Tablet (640-1023 px) renders document | inspector with Outline and Pages as inspector tabs; Mobile (below 640 px) renders one column. The size container is .tm-document-editor__main (the workspace and the status bar), NOT the root or the ribbon: a size container is the containing block of fixed descendants and the ribbon pickers, dialogs and the floating root position against the viewport. F6 / Shift+F6 cycle the landmarks header, ribbon, navigation, document, inspector (data-focus-region).

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Stable document id to load from the provider.

parameters.name: PageFitMode
parameters.description: How the canvas engine fits the page to the document column. Auto (default) fits the page only when the column is narrower than the page - a desktop container of 1024 - 1400 px next to the docked inspector, a tablet, a phone - and never enlarges it; Off leaves the zoom alone; FitWidth always follows the width. The reader's own zoom wins over the fit until "Automatic" (Ctrl+0) or "Page width" is chosen. Changing the parameter after mount applies the new mode at once and REPLACES the reader's zoom. A desktop container whose docked inspector would squeeze the fitted page below 75 percent presents the inspector as the overlay sheet instead (decision DE-AUTO-FIT-READABLE-FLOOR).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: A CSS length (600px, 100%, calc(100dvh - 5rem), clamp(20rem, 80dvh, 60rem), var(--host-height)) that bounds the height of the editor frame. null (default) keeps the editor in the flow of the page: it is as tall as its document and the page scrolls. With a value the frame is a flex column of that height - the header and the ribbon on top, the workspace in the middle, the status bar at the bottom - and the document region of the workspace is the one scroller (both axes), so the status bar is always visible, the horizontal scrollbar of a wide page is reachable without scrolling to the end of the document and the page itself does not scroll. The root gets data-frame="bounded"; the height is the custom property --tm-document-editor-height on the observer wrapper (.tm-document-editor-host), and the root renders no style attribute of its own. Only a number with a unit (px, rem, %, vh/dvh/svh/lvh, cqh, ...) or a calc / min / max / clamp / var expression is accepted; anything else (auto, none, inherit, a value with a semicolon or a brace) is ignored and the editor flows. A percentage needs a parent with a definite height - without one it resolves to auto and the editor flows at its natural height instead of collapsing. Fullscreen is the same frame at 100dvh; the reader's place in the document survives entering and leaving it and a change of Height.

parameters.name: PdfForensicWatermark
parameters.description: Optional forensic watermark stamped on every page of PDF exports (user name, export time, IP). The user name defaults to Author; hosts should fill the IP address and timestamp server-side so the stamp cannot be spoofed by the client.

parameters.name: ProofingProvider
parameters.description: Optional asynchronous proofing provider (e.g. the LanguageTool reference implementation from Tempo.Blazor.Proofing.LanguageTool). The editor extracts the document plain text, calls the provider after load and after edits (debounced by ProofingCheckDebounce), and merges the findings over ProofingOptions for the canvas squiggle overlay and spelling context menu. Provider failures are fail-open: the last known proofing state stays.

parameters.name: ProofingCheckDebounce
parameters.description: Debounce between an edit and the follow-up ProofingProvider pass.

parameters.name: RenderEngine
parameters.description: Legacy compatibility parameter. The editor is canvas-only and ignores this value.

parameters.name: OfflineStore
parameters.description: Optional offline draft store used when OfflineMode is enabled.

parameters.name: AuditFailureMode
parameters.description: Determines whether activity provider failures block editor workflows.

parameters.name: ActivityProvider
parameters.description: Optional activity provider used to record document editor audit events.

parameters.name: Author
parameters.description: Author used for save requests and audit events.

parameters.name: AutoSaveInterval
parameters.description: Optional autosave interval. Set to null to disable autosave.

parameters.name: CanComment
parameters.description: Whether the current user can add comments and replies.

parameters.name: CanDeleteOwnComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can delete their own comments.

parameters.name: CanResolveComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can resolve or reopen comment threads.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: CollaborationClientId
parameters.description: Stable collaboration client id for the current editor instance.

parameters.name: CollaborationProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider used to synchronize realtime collaborative edits.

parameters.name: CollaborationSyncInterval
parameters.description: Interval used to poll provider-backed collaboration updates.

parameters.name: ComparisonProvider
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to compare arbitrary document sources.

parameters.name: ContentControlRenderMode
parameters.description: Canvas content-control rendering mode. Use form for plain fill mode or design for structured-tag chrome.

parameters.name: DisabledFeatures
parameters.description: Feature names that should be disabled for this editor instance.

parameters.name: FontProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider for available editor font families.

parameters.name: FormatProvider
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to import and export external document formats.

parameters.name: ImageAssetOptions
parameters.description: Provider-managed image assets that can be inserted from the editor image menu.

parameters.name: ImageProvider
parameters.description: Optional image provider used by upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: ImageUrlResolver
parameters.description: Optional resolver for provider-managed document image assets.

parameters.name: ImageValidation
parameters.description: Image validation options used by upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Optional mention provider reused by the comment composer.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Current editor mode.

parameters.name: OfflineMode
parameters.description: Offline draft behavior for the editor. Defaults to disabled.

parameters.name: OnDocumentCompared
parameters.description: Raised after a document comparison completes.

parameters.name: OnDocumentFormatExported
parameters.description: Raised after the optional document format provider returns an export result.

parameters.name: OnDocumentLoaded
parameters.description: Raised after a document was loaded successfully.

parameters.name: OnPdfExported
parameters.description: Raised after the optional PDF export provider returns a result.

parameters.name: OnSaveRequested
parameters.description: Raised immediately before a save request is sent to the provider.

parameters.name: OnVersionCreated
parameters.description: Raised after a document version was created successfully.

parameters.name: PdfExportProvider
parameters.description: Optional host provider used to export the current document as PDF.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: Host-controlled permissions for the current user.

parameters.name: PreferLocalDraft
parameters.description: Whether a newer local draft should replace the server snapshot during load.

parameters.name: ProofingOptions
parameters.description: Optional proofing options used by the canvas engine spelling overlay.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Document editor provider used for load/save/version/comment operations.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the editor is read-only.

parameters.name: RequireMajorVersionDescription
parameters.description: Whether major versions require a non-empty description.

parameters.name: ShowComments
parameters.description: Whether the comments rail is displayed.

parameters.name: ShowDebugTools
parameters.description: Whether debug tools (View JSON etc.) are shown in the toolbar. Intended for development only.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Whether the Word-like toolbar/ribbon is displayed.

parameters.name: ShowVersionHistory
parameters.description: Whether the version history panel is displayed.

parameters.name: SigningRoles
parameters.description: Signer roles used to colour inline signing fields and to attribute placed fields (plan S2).

parameters.name: SigningFieldsChanged
parameters.description: Raised after a signing field is inserted, updated, or removed in the editor.

parameters.name: SuggestionProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider used to store and review document suggestions.

parameters.name: SuggestionsEnabled
parameters.description: Whether provider-backed suggestions start enabled.

parameters.name: SyncProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider used to submit an offline draft back to the authoritative store.

parameters.name: TokenProvider
parameters.description: Optional token provider reused by the document token autocomplete menu.

parameters.name: TokenValueProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider used to resolve template token values for preview.

parameters.name: ToolbarMode
parameters.description: Visual mode used by the document editor toolbar.

parameters.name: TrackChangesEnabled
parameters.description: Whether track changes starts enabled. With the canvas engine the effective flag (this value, or forced on by SuggestOnly / provider-backed suggestions) is pushed to the engine via setTrackChangesEnabled only on real deltas — the toolbar toggle and the parameter pass share one applied-state, so each value reaches the engine exactly once.

parameters.name: UseLocalComparisonFallback
parameters.description: Whether local comparison should be used if the comparison provider fails.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor chooses its layout. Auto (default) measures the editor's own container - a narrow host on a wide screen is a phone layout; the first frame is Desktop. A forced Desktop / Tablet / Mobile pins the layout and never imports the observer. Desktop (container of 1024 px and more): navigation | document | inspector; Tablet (640-1023 px): document | inspector with Outline and Pages as inspector tabs; Mobile (below 640 px): one column.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether the editor renders its header (title, save state, search, undo, redo, print preview, print to PDF when an export provider exists, save). Defaults to true. With false there is no header and Save / Undo / Redo stay in the ribbon quick-access group (the pre-redesign look, minus the in-surface page header).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Header title. Defaults to the title stored in the document metadata (a localized 'Untitled document' when empty).

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional second line of the header (a document type, a project name). Hidden when empty.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content rendered at the start of the header, before the title (a back link, a logo).

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host actions rendered at the end of the header, after Save (Share and similar). The editor itself offers no Share.
